description_en: Creates a backup for a specified PolarDB application and returns the backup job ID and workflow task ID
description_zh: 为指定 PolarDB 应用创建备份，并返回备份任务 ID 和工作流任务 ID
name: CreateApplicationBackup

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the application resides. The server uses the actual region of the application
parameters.help_zh: 应用所在地域的地域 ID；服务端以应用实际所在地域为准
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the application to back up
parameters.name: application_id

parameters.help_en: The application type, such as polarclaw
parameters.name: application_type

parameters.help_en: The backup mode. Automated indicates an automatic backup, and Manual indicates a manual backup
parameters.help_zh: 备份模式。Automated 表示自动备份，Manual 表示手动备份
parameters.name: job_mode

BackupJobId.description_en: The ID of the created backup job

TaskId.description_en: The ID of the workflow task corresponding to the backup creation
TaskId.description_zh: 创建备份对应的工作流任务 ID
